name: Somora — Kassio Studio
description: I'm Somora's creator. Somora combines AI music generation with Kassio Studio, a browser DAW in beta, free for registered users on every plan. Import audio, arrange clips, edit piano-roll notes, add drums and instruments, mix tracks, save projects to your account and export WAV. AI composition and music generation have separate free and paid allowances. Screenshot: https://somora.media/assets/kassio-studio.png
